args.description: One broken antique sea-green stone column and arch stub with a few restrained ivory shell inlays and muted warm coral at its foot, side-view front facing pixel art environmental prop. Crisp silhouette, 3-tone broad masonry, no particles. Match Dungeon Matcher crisp native pixel-art: no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or noisy individual speckles. Top-left light.
